title: Neck To Choke - Free Security Scanner for AI-Generated Code
excerpt: You shipped AI code. Is it secure? Probably not. Free security scanner checks your AI-built apps for vulnerabilities in seconds.
content_html:
Yes, it's safe.

This scanner only reads publicly available information from your site. We don't store your data, we don't modify anything, and we don't hack. Think of it like a security-conscious friend checking if you left your front door unlocked.

Your link is safe to share here. We're developers who've seen AI mislead good people, and we're here to help.
